title: Good app, pushing premium too hard
body: I like the app, its very simple and clean. I have adhd so for me it’s hard to find something that can work good and not be distracting. But I take -3 stars for how pushy it is with premium. You open the app - it shows a window you have to close. Although they have a button in the bottom always showing, if you want a premium it’s right there. Then after couple of days they put huge banner on the habits page that you CAN NOT CLOSE! It’s so annoying and frustrating, also distracting! This is how you get people not to want to use the app. I subscribe to ones that work well for a while and I want to support. Not the ones that push it down your throat.

title: Challenges are game changer
body: I just wish there were more challenges by Habitify. Top lists really motivate me. I'm glad Habitify syncs with Apple Health. Well worth the lifetime payment.

title: The must powerful habit tracker app!
body:
A 3 years of using Habitify I can say that’s no other app can do what the Habitify did for me, it’s powerful features, simple, best UI, fast, available on all Apple devices, I love it .

author: ELIDIZER

title: Needs polishing
body:
UI is a great improvement over previous version but functionality and performance still need some love. App stutters on basic animations and life-time subscription doesn't seem to have effect on adding multiple reminders so I get prompted to purchase the full version every time. 

Update: Stop asking for reviews
